description.value: Pho Japolo is a proudly family-run Vietnamese and Japanese fusion restaurant operating since 1995, with the Kitsilano outpost anchoring a four-location Lower Mainland chain. The menu spans hearty beef noodle soups with a range of traditional pho combinations alongside inventive sushi creations like sushi pizza and sushi burgers. Regulars highlight the generous portions, warm homey atmosphere, and reliably consistent food as reasons to keep coming back.
